5,409 likes, 69 comments - garyvee on October 21, 2026: "Click the link below to watch the full episode 🎥

Garyvee.com/np

 You can always change your mind. You might not want to do anything related to business for three years and then think, “Fuck! I miss it,” and go back to work even harder.

I am only interested in you enjoying your life, because we’ve only got one. Life is not a binary game, my friends. Shit changes.

If you listen to this podcast episode with @nudeproject and only hear this message, it’s a win.

Drop a 🖐️ if you get it!".
